sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Melfel is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. He is a Demonlord of Nogreth and is Elhaza's servant.

sections.title: In Brave Frontier I
sections.content: As part of the Battles of Brave Frontier 2 series, Melfel can be fought in The Illusionist.

sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: The disaster in St. Creek was only a practice round for Sertavia. One of the Seven Demonlords of Nogreth's forces, Melfel is a cunning and tricky foe who excels at taunting and manipulating his opponents. A considerable amount of evidence found suggests that Melfel was involved in a lot of the chaos caused in different worlds even before Nogreth ever invaded Sertavia, which may suggest that he has been causing trouble from the shadows for quite some time now. However, it was not until he ran into a number of young warriors trying to protect their homeland that he finally showed himself, interfering in their affairs at every opportunity. Not only did he hope to stall their advancement with his antics, but it was also his duty to get rid of them by orders of Elhaza.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - Melfel was responsible for the destruction of St. Creek 20 years prior to the start of Brave Frontier
